comment: The environment the audit measures in. `version` must equal the @playwright/test version in package.json, which build/check-version.mjs enforces: a runner built against one API driving browsers from another is a failure with a confusing symptom. `digest` pins the image contents, so the fonts and the renderer are the same bytes on a developer's machine and on a CI runner. The Makefile reads this file; the workflow cannot, so it repeats the reference and check-version.mjs compares the two.
